summary.text: Sam Zurier is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 3 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sam Zurier graduated from Classical High School in 1976, earned a B.A. in mathematics from Yale University in 1980, an M.A. in politics and economics from Oxford University in 1984, and a J.D. from Yale in 1986.
His career experience includes working as an attorney, as an assistant Massachusetts attorney general, and as a law clerk to then-First Circuit Court of Appeals Judge Stephen Breyer.
Zurier represented Ward 2 on the Providence City Council from 2011 to 2018.
He took office in the State Senate on November 16, 2021, succeeding Gayle Goldin, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
